entities.name: T3324 value
entities.description: Timer value for Power Saving Mode (PSM) operation, included by the network in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message under specific conditions.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request tracking area update procedure.

entities.name: UE included T3324 value IE in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Condition where UE indicates support for PSM by including T3324 value IE in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

entities.name: Network supports PSM and accepts its use
entities.description: Condition where network has PSM capability and accepts UE's request to use Power Saving Mode.

entities.name: Network includes T3324 value IE
entities.description: Network behavior of including T3324 value IE in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message when conditions are met.

relations.description: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message may contain T3324 value IE when UE supports PSM.
Network includes T3324 value IE only if UE included it in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST.
Network includes T3324 value IE only if network supports PSM and accepts its use.
UE including T3324 value IE in request establishes network behavior to include it in response.
Network supporting PSM establishes network behavior to include T3324 value IE.
